Alerts

Inline and persistent, placed next to whatever they are about. The glyph carries the same meaning as the color, so the message still reads without it.

info
Your trial has 14 days left.
check_circle
Deployment finished All 24 services reported healthy within two minutes.
warning
Storage almost full You are using 94% of your quota. Older backups will stop being created at 100%.
error
Payment failed The card ending 4242 was declined. Update it to avoid an interruption.
lightbulb
Press ? anywhere to see the keyboard shortcuts.

Banners

One per screen, at the top of the content, for something that affects the whole page. It stays until it is acted on or dismissed.

cloud_off
You are offline. Changes are saved locally and will sync when the connection comes back.
cookie
We use a single cookie to remember your theme. Nothing is shared with anyone.

Toasts

Brief confirmation of something that already happened. One line, at most one action, and never anything the visitor must read.

From script

UI.toast('Conversation archived', {
  action: 'Undo',
  onAction: function () { restore(); },
  duration: 6000,      // 0 keeps it until dismissed
  variant: 'success'   // success | danger | warning
});

Tooltips

A short label for a control that has none. Never put anything in a tooltip that the visitor needs — it is unreachable on touch and easy to miss.

Archive Delete permanently A longer tooltip that wraps onto several lines. Still only ever supporting detail. help_outline Reachable with the keyboard too

Dialogs

Built on the native dialog element, so focus trapping, the backdrop, Escape and the top layer are all handled by the browser.

How interrupting?

ComponentBlocks the pageGoes awayUse for
Inline hintNoNeverGuidance attached to one field.
AlertNoOn dismissStatus about one part of the page.
ToastNoAfter a few secondsConfirming something that already happened.
BannerNoOn actionSomething affecting the whole page.
DialogYesOn a decisionA choice that cannot be deferred.
